tool_suggestions.title: Vendor Performance Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard for operations to track and compare vendor performance through ratings and pricing.
features: Vendor list with rating and price comparison
Graphical analysis of vendor performance over time
Filter vendors by location and service category
Detailed view with recent communication history

tool_suggestions.title: Event Budget Management Interface
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a tool for finance teams to track, allocate, and manage event budgets and expenses.
features: Budget allocation and tracking for each event
Dashboard with alerts for overspend risks

tool_suggestions.title: Attendee Registration and Check-in Manager
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design a tool for event coordinators to monitor and manage attendee registration and check-ins seamlessly.
features: Real-time dashboard of attendee registration status
Check-in interface with QR code scanning
Alerts for VIP attendees and special needs
